data_scope: Ethereum canonical historical block headers; no attack labels
cooldown_clock: historical event_time; anchored on last emitted notification
budget_clock: playback decision UTC day, after grouping
fragment_selection: UTC hour with greatest sum of transaction_count within source day; ties earliest hour; selected before detector execution
fragment_role: exploratory intensity stress slice of the same day, not an independent case
queue_model: virtual single-server FCFS, measured local service duration; no paced wall-clock wait
finality_scope: historical canonical snapshot assumed settled; consensus finality not independently verified
claim_scope: implementation feasibility and local cost; no detector quality, real acquisition latency or attack recall claim
